summary: Repository checks name one authority class — structural, real-tool, textual-guard, or warn-only. Invariants owned by types, tests, or generated digests are not restated by scanners; genuine static analysis wraps a pinned real tool and declares only exceptions; hand-written textual guards are legal only for invisible-failure classes with documented false-positive shape and a named retirement end-state; heuristic verdicts never block. check-store-boundary.py is replaced under the real-tool rule and check-tx-scope.py is deleted at its named structural end-state.
title: Repository checks are structural first, and textual guards are declared exceptions
